requirements.reason: Capabilities report actual Rust/Python/runtime surfaces; CLI adds its own surface. Existing catalog/profile v1 retained unchanged by upstream; v2 principles adopted explicitly without relabeling the v1 document.
No catalog or binding surface removed; optional CLI absent from core discovery. Required runtime present.
REST profile declares no intentional surface absence; no successor REST catalog exists at this revision.

Known response/file/pagination bounds return resource_limit, including partial results. No aggregate JSON materialization budget; allocation exhaustion may terminate the process. Re-entry: bounded serialization and host budget with boundary tests.
Discovery advertises binding v2/version 2; envelope contract and capability/operation selectors remain v1. Exported RUNTIME_INTERFACE_CONTRACT retains its documented envelope meaning.
REST is a destination, not a sender or destination selector. Host must negotiate from discovery.
No transport ingress, forwarding, retry/redrive store or routing in this component. Context belongs outside the envelope to the host.
Cleanup after proven download publication preserves committed effect and never retry.
Transport failures retain io and deadlines timeout with unknown effect, never internal merely because the outcome is unknown; no database commit protocol exposed.

Every REST operation already declares remote. CLI returns JSON and adds no stricter effect; optional surface_side_effects must be absent, since no value is stricter than remote. Destinations for download are explicit inputs.
Opt-in Arrow geometry interoperability; REST exchanges JSON and opaque artifacts, no Arrow contract or operation advertised.
Decisions 0016 and geometry semantics apply to Arrow adopters; no geometry interpretation in REST.
Decision 0017 REST-to-Arrow adapter is owned by the application; this component provides no such adapter and makes no Arrow conversion claim.
Contract gate emits fixed error text, including unexpected exceptions; values, schema diagnostics and paths are never rendered.
Upstream gate_fuzz verdict-cache registry fix only. This repository has cargo-fuzz and no verdict cache; no workflow cache to invalidate. Upstream oracle is tested offline separately.
